verdict.rationale: Requesty lets you give an agent its own key: service accounts create non-human entities with their own keys, and each API key or service account can carry its own monthly spend cap. The changelog confirms the budget field exists in the management API. Per-key rate limiting is not documented; the only rate-limit mention is upstream provider rate limits triggering fallbacks. Missing for 10: documented per-key request/token rate limits, finer-grained (non-monthly) budget windows, independent or hands-on corroboration that caps hard-stop an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can give an autonomous agent its own key with budget and rate guardrails so it cannot run away on spend

citations.quote: Each API key or service account can have its own monthly spend cap.
Service accounts allow you create non-human entities... spend from those keys will not be tied to any user.
`monthly_limit` is deprecated and will soon be migrated to `monthly_budget`
